summary: The upstream repair landed: src/features/report-center/ now holds the 8 report files, src/features/reports/ is gone, and src/App.tsx, src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx import @/features/report-center/*. On that tree the unit's local Done-when passes (node scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs exit 0, 6/6; node --check of both smokes exit 0) and the full node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs now passes 8/8 (exit 0): the package carries 216 files with the four new migrations, the questionnaire assets and manifest schema_version 2; a 0.1.0 install with owner data is overlaid with the current package, pnpm install and the vite build run, the app boots on PORT/BACKEND_PORT, companies, diagnoses, drafts and preferences are identical, the four new tables exist and the questionnaire files are in place. manifest.json, system.json and package.json are at 0.2.0, schema_version 2, requires_migration true. No file of this unit was edited in this round: the earlier r0 to r2 work (version bump, smoke-migrate, smoke-store-package including assertPackageContents and the descriptor cleanup) already covers the repaired tree.

findings.summary: A real 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 update of an installation with data through the AIOSON Play (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta, or a local package) and the green badge were not run: they need the Play desktop app, which this environment cannot run. scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs reproduces the same flow (v1 install, owner data, overlay of the current package, pnpm install, boot, data comparison) and passes 8/8.

A packager output of an earlier inspection run existed before this unit's smoke runs and `aioson system:package .` rewrites it on every smoke run (now 1304139 bytes, with the report-center files). scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs removes only the descriptor it created itself, so this pre-existing file stays. A delete by hand was denied earlier in this unit and was not retried. It is outside this unit's write paths and safe to delete.

messages.text: AC-ra-54 store smoke is green on the renamed tree (node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs exit 0, 8/8, about 5 minutes, foreground). Remaining integration checks of the phase that are not part of this unit: pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm test:e2e, node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs, aioson harness:check . --slug=relatorios-e-acompanhamento, and the manual Play update of a v1 installation with data (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta, or local package) to confirm the data and the green badge.

The aioson packager skips any folder named 'reports' at any depth (DEV_ONLY_DIRS). Any future folder with that name under src/, server/ or shared/ would be dropped from the store package again; scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs (assertPackageContents) fails with the list of dropped files if that happens. .aioson/system-packages/fitpulse/fitpulse-0.2.0.json is a stray packager output that may be deleted.
